name: OpenTune virtual car (demo)
author: OpenTune contributors
description: Definitions for the 'vcar' virtual-car driver's built-in demo profile (crates/drivers/vcar/profiles/demo.json): module list for auto-scan, coding, adaptation and service scripts for its six simulated modules.
